blind.description: A stylized fantasy wooden weapon and shield rack. It consists of a sturdy timber frame with two vertical end posts reinforced with square metal pyramid studs, resting on wide stabilizing feet, and supporting a paneled wooden backboard. On the front face, three small heater shields are mounted (red-and-white, green-and-white, and white-and-red), above four vertically racked bludgeoning weapons (a spiked morningstar mace, a square war hammer, a flanged mace, and another war hammer) resting in a lower slot. The reverse side shows clean vertical wooden planks framed by the beams. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and cartoon-textured in painted warm brown wood and dulled steel metal.
blind.from_above: A horizontal brown rectangular wooden beam bounded by square post caps on each end, with small feet extending perpendicular at the bottom, and the slight curved tops of shields and weapon heads protruding from the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 ft tall (a bit over half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 3.5 to 4 ft wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.53x off the catalog (5.0 x 1.9 ft)
